levels.title: Beginner
levels.description: Greet people, introduce yourself, order at a café, shop, find your way and talk about your day.

levels.title: Elementary
levels.description: Talk about the past, travel, health, home, work and plans; handle phone calls and complaints.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.description: Give opinions, tell stories, talk about feelings, work, media and the francophone world.

levels.title: Upper intermediate
levels.description: Debate, negotiate, run meetings, follow the news and use idioms naturally.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.description: Switch register, master spoken French, persuade, present and handle delicate conversations.

levels.title: Mastery
levels.description: Speak with precision, irony and wit, and navigate French from Québec to Dakar.

tracks.title: Pronunciation
tracks.description: Train the sounds English speakers find hard: u vs ou, nasal vowels, the French r, silent letters, liaison, é/è, eu, rhythm and intonation. New units unlock as you reach each level.
